## 5. One Non-Obvious Thing I Noticed

**The gap between the system's architecture and its operational reality is widening, not closing.**

WOLF ran 78 consecutive streak days (per `wolf_capabilities`) and built out 58 scripts, 14 core modules, 12 committee personas — yet the PRAXIS capture pipeline has produced exactly one block ever (the bootstrap). The Construct was designed as a multi-agent epistemological system, but as of today it is running as a single-agent live-data logger. The infrastructure for collective intelligence (promotions/, construct-standup/, praxis-daily-review/, all 19 agents) exists in the repo skeleton but nothing feeds it except WOLF.

More pointedly: WOLF stopped 48 hours ago and there is no watchdog. No other agent noticed, no alert fired, no standup ran automatically. The system has no redundancy and no self-monitoring at the construct level — only at the circuit-breaker level inside WOLF itself. The standup cadence needs to be the outer heartbeat that catches WOLF going dark.
